_why: Owner ruling 21 Oct 2026: AI-generated photorealistic pictures on the four service pages, no captions (owner ruling 21 Oct 2026: no "Example styling" caption), descriptive alt text, never presented as a past customer job. Generated at $0 with Workers AI @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell (free allowance, the same model as assets/rentals) by scripts/generators/build_service_ai_images.mjs, center-cropped to 1024x768 WebP. Each picture was checked by eye: no faces, no text, no logos; rental pictures show only availableNow items (owner ruling 21 Oct 2026), listed in items. sha1 pins the approved bytes: scripts/validators/validate_no_placeholder_images.mjs and validate_service_pages.js fail on any ai-*.webp that is not registered here with its hash. Owner ruling 21 Oct 2026: the party page's AI pictures "are not good enough" and were replaced by five owner-provided photos (source "owner", assets/img/<service>/owner-*.webp, registered by sha1 like the AI ones; "pages" lists every page that shows one); the hotel room setups page shows the bedroom, hallway and anniversary photos and the baby shower pages the shower + teddy pair. The grazing page's first two AI pictures were regenerated the same day (owner: "not good").
